headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Deccan Chronicle / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Olympic Glory Comes at a Heavy Price.
BRS complains to Chief Secretary over protocol violations.
A.P. records 77.65% turnout in first-phase panchayat polls, 63.44% in 23 urban local bodies.
ABVP bags all nine seats in Goa University Students’ Council elections.
Andhra Pradesh seeks 90% Central aid for ₹4,851-crore cyclone-resilient power project.
bullets_ur: Olympic ki kamyabi ki bhari qeemat chukani parti hai.
BRS ki protocol ki khilaf-warzi par Chief Secretary se shikayat.
A.P. mein pehle marhalay ke panchayat chunao mein 77.65% aur 23 urban local bodies mein 63.44% voting hui.
ABVP ne Goa University ke Students’ Council intikhabat mein nau ke nau seetein jeet liyeen.
Andhra Pradesh ka ₹4,851 crore ke cyclone-resilient power project ke liye 90% markazi imdad ka mutaliba.
